{{Quote|A short while ago, a group of defiant revolutionaries destroyed an Imperial dreadnaught. Three thousand people were aboard&mdash;including Darth Jadus, a Lord of the Dark Council. We chose to strike at Darth Jadus publicly so that every Imperial citizen would know the truth: The Dark Council is not invulnerable. We can effect change. We regret the sacrifice of so many civilians, but it was necessary. The Empire cannot cover up this momentous event. Imperial Intelligence cannot silence our call to arms.|The Eagle's speech claiming responsibility|<ref name="TOR:CUtM" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Jadus]] faked the '''destruction''' of his [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], allowing the [[Eagle's network]] to claim responsibility for the attack. The widely-publicized attack, believed to have claimed the lives of the three thousand people aboard, sparked [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[hunt for the Eagle]], though it was later discovered that Jadus had faked the attack and survived along with the ''Dominator''.
